title: Bulbul
blurb: The bulbuls are members of a family, Pycnonotidae, of medium-sized passerine songbirds, which also includes greenbuls, brownbuls, leafloves, and bristlebills.
facts: A few insular species occur on the tropical islands of the Indian Ocean.
